title: Contagion Bias
coreMove: Detect when the contagion bias pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
sourcePressure: The frozen TOC and official source notes frame Contagion Bias as a specific decision error around contagion bias, sympathetic magic, once in contact. Traceable support includes contagion heuristic.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Contagion Bias as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: detect when the contagion bias pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.

sourceAnchors.name: contagion heuristic
sourceAnchors.detail: Contagion bias is also called the ' contagion heuristic ' . The one-line summary of the contagion bias: ' Once in contact, always in contact. ' Thomas Gilovich, Dale Griffin, Daniel Kahneman (editors), Heuristics and Biases: The Psychology of Intuitive Judgment (Cambridge Univers
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: contagion heuristic can appear as a factual pressure point: the reader sees contagion bias through evidence, not a decorative citation.
